scope: Full-volume elastic energy with fixed exterior and three interior mesh densities; diagnostic, not a substitute for convergence gates
identity: 2U = u dot (external load + contact force + gauge force), using final clipped contact forces
limitations: Energy diagnostic does not replace peak stress/displacement convergence gates
P1 constant strain per tetrahedron and isotropic assumed materials
Contact energy not added to elastic energy; identity uses final contact force work
No peak exclusion or physical material qualification
